# datadog_action_connection_v2 (Resource)

Provides a Datadog action connection resource generated from the API specification.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "datadog_action_connection_v2" "example" {
  name = "AWS connection"
  tags = ["env:staging"]
  integration = {
    aws_integration = {
      type = "AWS"
      credentials = {
        aws_assume_role = {
          type       = "AWSAssumeRole"
          account_id = "111222333444"
          role       = "DatadogWorkflowRole"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `integration` (Attributes) The definition of `ActionConnectionIntegration` object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--integration))
- `name` (String) Name of the connection

### Optional

- `external_secrets_manager` (Attributes) AWS Secrets Manager settings shared by the credential references on a `DATACENTER` connection. These settings are required whenever a field uses an AWS Secrets Manager reference. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--external_secrets_manager))
- `tags` (List of String) Tags associated with the connection. Each tag must follow the `key:value` format.
The `default` tag key is reserved.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
